title: IOE Lớp 4 - Chuyên đề 3 - Vòng Quốc Gia

part_A.question: Shopkeeper: Good morning, sir. Can I help you?- Mr. Green: …
options: D. I want to drink coffee.
part_A.explanation: "Shopkeeper: Can I help you? – Mr. Green: I'd like some pork." – Hỏi đáp trong cửa hàng; "I'd like" = tôi muốn.

part_A.question: What subject do you like the most? - ... .
options: A. Today I have English and Music
B. I like Maths the most
C. I don’t like Music because I can’t sing
D. Yes, I like it very much
part_A.answer: B. I like Maths the most
part_A.explanation: "What subject do you like the most? – I like Maths the most." – "the most" = nhất; hỏi môn học yêu thích nhất.

part_A.question: My grandmother is 76 years old. She likes … photographs very much.
part_A.explanation: "My grandmother likes taking photographs very much." – like + V-ing; "taking photographs" = chụp ảnh.

part_A.question: I like listening to music and dancing so I go to the ... club every week.
part_A.explanation: "I go to the music club every week." – "music club" = câu lạc bộ âm nhạc; "every week" = mỗi tuần.

part_A.question: There are … students in my class. Twenty boys and twenty girls.
part_A.explanation: "There are forty students in my class. Twenty boys and twenty girls." – 20+20=40; "forty" = bốn mươi.

part_A.question: Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word: mor__ng
part_A.explanation: "mor_ni_ng" → "morning" = buổi sáng; điền "ni". "Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word."

part_A.question: Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word: st__t
part_A.explanation: "st_ar_t" → "start" = bắt đầu; điền "ar". "Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word."

part_A.question: Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word: cla__room
part_A.explanation: "cla_ss_room" → "classroom" = phòng học; điền "ss". "Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word."

part_A.question: Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word: phot__raph
part_A.explanation: "phot_og_raph" → "photograph" = bức ảnh; điền "og". "Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word."

part_A.question: Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word: e___cise
part_A.explanation: "e_xer_cise" → "exercise" = bài tập/tập thể dục; điền "xer". "Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word."

part_A.question: Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word: t__ice
part_A.explanation: "t_w_ice" → "twice" = hai lần; điền "w". "Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word."

part_A.question: Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word: tomo__ow
part_A.explanation: "tomo_rr_ow" → "tomorrow" = ngày mai; điền "rr". "Choose the letter(s) to make a correct word."

part_A.question: You should do morning ... It is good for your health.
part_A.explanation: "You should do morning exercise. It is good for your health." – "should" = nên; tập thể dục buổi sáng tốt cho sức khoẻ.

part_A.question: What lessons have you got … Monday? - … have got English, PE and Maths.
part_A.explanation: "What lessons have you got on Monday? – I have got English, PE and Maths." – "on" trước thứ.

part_A.question: A: … - B: No, I am not. I am Japanese.
options: A. Are you Chinese or Korean?
part_A.explanation: "Are you Korean? – No, I am not. I am Japanese." – Hỏi quốc tịch; phủ định và xác nhận quốc tịch đúng.

part_A.question: Mary’s birthday is in the eighth month. 'The eighth month' means: ... .
part_A.explanation: "Mary's birthday is in the eighth month." – "The eighth month" = August (tháng 8).

part_A.question: I’m looking at lots of old things. I’m in the ___.
part_A.explanation: "I'm looking at lots of old things. I'm in the museum." – "museum" = viện bảo tàng; nơi trưng bày đồ cổ.

part_A.question: School started at 7 o’clock. Tom arrived at school at 7.10 then he was … .
part_A.explanation: "School started at 7.00. Tom arrived at 7.10 then he was late." – 7:10 > 7:00 → muộn (late).

part_A.question: I like listening to music and dancing so I go to the ... club on Saturday evening.
part_A.explanation: "I go to the art club on Saturday evening." – "art club" = câu lạc bộ mỹ thuật; hội hoạ và khiêu vũ.

part_A.question: ... notebooks are there in your schoolbag? – There are 3 notebooks.
part_A.explanation: "How many notebooks are there in your schoolbag? – There are 3 notebooks." – "How many + danh từ số nhiều?"

part_A.question: Jane has a lot of ... to do, so she can’t go with us tonight.
part_A.explanation: "Jane has a lot of homework to do, so she can't go with us tonight." – "a lot of homework" = nhiều bài tập.

part_A.question: Don’t talk to me now. I ... an important letter.
part_A.explanation: "Don't talk to me now. I am writing an important letter." – Hiện tại tiếp diễn; "important letter" = thư quan trọng.

part_A.question: Mary is reading books in the … . She comes there every weekend.
part_A.explanation: "Mary is reading books in the library. She comes there every weekend." – "library" = thư viện; cuối tuần.

part_A.question: How often do you visit your grandmother? – I visit my grandmother ___.
part_A.explanation: "How often do you visit your grandmother? – I visit my grandmother twice a month." – "twice a month" = 2 lần/tháng.

part_A.question: What is the ______ of your school? – It’s in Ly Thuong Kiet Street.
part_A.explanation: "What is the address of your school? – It's in Ly Thuong Kiet Street." – "address" = địa chỉ.

part_A.question: I don’t like … food such as ice-creams, birthday cakes or lollipops.
part_A.explanation: "I don't like sweet food such as ice-creams, birthday cakes or lollipops." – "sweet food" = đồ ngọt.

part_A.question: Tom: When is ... in Vietman, Quan? - Quan: It’s on the first of June.
part_A.explanation: "Tom: When is Children's Day in Vietnam? – Quan: It's on the first of June." – "Children's Day" = Ngày Thiếu nhi.

part_A.question: I’m walking with my dog. I’m looking at the trees. I’m in the ___.
part_A.explanation: "I'm walking with my dog. I'm looking at the trees. I'm in the park." – "park" = công viên.

part_A.question: What does she do in the afternoon? - ________
options: B. She plays badminton in the playground.
C. She swam in the swimming pool.
D. She is singing her favourite song.
part_A.answer: B. She plays badminton in the playground.
part_A.explanation: "What does she do in the afternoon? – She plays badminton in the playground." – Hỏi thói quen buổi chiều.

part_A.question: Students don’t go to school at .... There are no classes on Saturday.
part_A.explanation: "Students don't go to school at weekend. There are no classes on Saturday." – "weekend" = cuối tuần (không có lớp).

part_A.question: I’m in Class 4G. My school’s name is ______.
options: A. Nguyen Binh Khiem Primary School
C. Nguyen Gia Thieu High School
part_A.answer: A. Nguyen Binh Khiem Primary School
part_A.explanation: "I'm in Class 4G. My school's name is Nguyen Binh Khiem Primary School." – Giới thiệu trường lớp.

part_A.question: My grandmother is … a letter to her friend in London now.
part_A.explanation: "My grandmother is writing a letter to her friend in London now." – Hiện tại tiếp diễn; "writing a letter".

part_A.question: Waiter: Would you like some beef, Sir? - Mr. Smith: No, I don’t eat meat. I’d like some …, please.
part_A.explanation: "Waiter: Would you like some beef? – Mr. Smith: No, I don't eat meat. I'd like some salad, please." – Gọi món ăn.

part_A.question: His mother works as a ... at Oxford Primary School. She teaches English.
part_A.explanation: "His mother works as a teacher at Oxford Primary School. She teaches English." – Nghề giáo viên.

part_A.question: There are … students in my class. Twenty boys and eighteen girls.
part_A.explanation: "There are thirty-eight students in my class. Twenty boys and eighteen girls." – 20+18=38; "thirty-eight".

part_A.question: Tom never skips his breakfast. Then in the afternoon, he always has … at the school canteen.
part_A.explanation: "Tom never skips his breakfast. Then he always has lunch at the school canteen." – "skip" = bỏ bữa; "canteen" = căng-tin.

part_A.question: John and Peter were … yesterday evening. They watched TV and listened to music.
part_A.explanation: "John and Peter were at home yesterday evening. They watched TV and listened to music." – "at home" = ở nhà.

part_A.question: Tom: … - Mary: My school has 2 floors.
options: A. How many floors is these in your school?
B. How much floors is there in your school?
C. How many floors are there in your school?
D. How much floors are there in your school?
part_A.answer: C. How many floors are there in your school?
part_A.explanation: "Tom: How many floors are there in your school? – Mary: My school has 2 floors." – Hỏi đáp về số tầng trường.

part_A.question: Teacher: Where were you yesterday, Alex? - Alex: I was at the … to learn about wild animals.
part_A.explanation: "Teacher: Where were you yesterday, Alex? – I was at the nature park to learn about wild animals." – "nature park" = công viên thiên nhiên.

part_A.question: Alice: What do you like, Mai? - Mai: …
options: B. I like singing and reading comics.
C. My favourite food is beef.
D. I often get up at 6 o’clock.
part_A.answer: B. I like singing and reading comics.
part_A.explanation: "Alice: What do you like, Mai? – Mai: I like singing and reading comics." – Hỏi sở thích; liệt kê với "and".

part_A.question: Joe’s mother is in the garden. She … dinner in the kitchen.
part_A.explanation: "Joe's mother is in the garden. She isn't cooking dinner in the kitchen." – Phủ định hiện tại tiếp diễn.

part_A.question: What are your classmates doing? - ___
options: A. They paint pictures in the Art room.
B. They are painting pictures in the Art room.
C. They painting pictures in the Art room.
D. They painted pictures in the Art room.
part_A.answer: B. They are painting pictures in the Art room.
part_A.explanation: "What are your classmates doing? – They are painting pictures in the Art room." – Hiện tại tiếp diễn câu hỏi + trả lời.

part_A.question: A: What do you do at 6 p.m. every day? - B: …
options: A. I love reading comic books.
B. I watch Cartoon Network on TV.
C. I am reading a book in my room.
D. I often have lunch at home.
part_A.answer: B. I watch Cartoon Network on TV.
part_A.explanation: "A: What do you do at 6 p.m. every day? – B: I watch Cartoon Network on TV." – Hỏi thói quen cụ thể.

part_A.question: … is your favourite singer? - Celine Dion - an American French singer.
part_A.explanation: "Who is your favourite singer? – Celine Dion – an American French singer." – "Who" hỏi về người cụ thể.

part_A.question: Nam: Why are you very good at Science and English? - Anh: Because they're my favourite school ___.
part_A.explanation: "Why are you very good at Science and English? – Because they're my favourite school subjects." – "because" = vì; giải thích lý do.

part_A.question: I go swim_ _ _ _ on Sunday afternoons.

part_A.question: His favourite _ _ _ _ is chicken.

part_A.explanation: "hide-and-_seek_" → "seek" = tìm; điền "seek". "hide-and-seek" = trò trốn tìm.

part_A.explanation: "b_oard_" → "board" = bảng; điền "oard". "go to the board and write your sentence."

part_A.explanation: "p_refer_" → "prefer" = thích hơn; điền "refer". "I prefer tea." = Tôi thích trà hơn.

part_A.explanation: "_hobb_y" → "hobby" = sở thích; điền "hobb". "What's your hobby? – I like taking photos."

part_A.explanation: Sắp xếp: "Can I borrow your ruler or you are using it at the moment?" – Xin mượn đồ dùng học tập.
